title: Mysteries From Above
description:
S02 E05 — Behind the Myths
Revealing the truth behind the planet's ancient legends; touring an island covered in polar bears, twin craters in Greece, peeking at a supervolcano hidden under Yellowstone Park and examining an ocean formation that's eerily similar to Atlantis.

title: Mysteries From Above
description:
S02 E06 — Giants
Walking among colossal wonders scattered across the Earth's surface, including an ancient reptile skeleton, a massive head carving in the Alberta badlands, a giant South African footprint and a pentagram etched into a remote peninsula in Kazakhstan.

title: Mysteries From Above
description:
S02 E07 — Mysterious Monuments
Traipsing along ancient pathways crisscrossing Easter Island; finding gigantic designs carved into Asia's Eastern Steppe; ascending a tall pyramid rising from Antarctica's icy landscape.

title: Mysteries From Above
description:
S02 E08 — A Whole Lot of Holes
Exploring some of the most cavernous places on the planet, including an expansive Siberian crater with no explainable origin, Greenland's bizarre black holes, an ancient forbidden well in the Yemeni desert, and a voluminous void in Antarctica.

title: Mysteries From Above
description:
S02 E09 — From Far Above
A perfect circle carved around an ancient peak; a scary phenomenon in the Pacific; strange shapes in a Middle Eastern desert; a formation below the ocean's surface.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E07 — Dodging Death
A brush with death is terrifying enough-but these stories take survival to the extreme; like fending off a black bear while dangling off a cliff; drifting through shark-infested waters with nothing but a pair of rubber boots to stay afloat.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E02 — Bizarre Deaths
In Boston, a 25-foot tidal wave of molasses; a dancing plague that kills 100 people; a surgery with a 300% mortality rate; searching the globe for the strangest and most bizarre deaths on record.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E17 — Astonishing Escapes
We've heard the tales of successful prison breaks, but these aren't your average escapes; from a man who frees himself all thanks to a stone fruit, to a Soviet pilot that evades capture by stealing the enemy's plane.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E15 — Unexpected Spectacles
Imagine a man floating through the sky by dozens of balloons or a circus only visible via magnifying glass; these are the tales of history's most unbelievable, strange and completely unexpected spectacles.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E10 — Against All Odds
Some of the world's most valiant figures overcome the most bizarre circumstances; like a man who survives the apocalypse, or a woman involved in not one, but three maritime disasters; these are the stories of survival against all odds.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E01 — It Came From Above
Wondering about bizarre things that have fallen from the sky; from meteorites to seafood, and even bathtubs, these are some unbelievable stories of what comes from above.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E17 — Odd Origins
Uncovering the wild beginnings behind ordinary objects, legendary figures, and even the sayings we use every day.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E01 — Strange Places
Exploring the Lake Michigan Triangle and many other wild and weird places, including a doll-filled island with a dark past, deadly gas-filled explosive lakes, caves that harbor deadly viruses and a haunted place in the United States.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S04 E01 — Epic Fails
A miracle cure with a deadly catch; A romantic gesture explodes in a president's face; A simple home repair spirals wildly out of control; Sometimes the biggest disasters begin with the best intentions.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S04 E02 — Peculiar Places
A bleeding house; a near-boiling river; a desert of unexplained encounters; these are peculiar places on Earth.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S02 E06 — Primal Fears
Among the myriad emotions humans have experienced over centuries, perhaps the most easily identifiable is fear; it is because it is essential to our very survival.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S01 E15 — Monster Mayhem
Analyzing if monsters exist, creatures who lurk in dense forests or fly over large cities; for centuries, monsters like Mothman, the Thunderbird, and Bigfoot have mystified witnesses, skeptics, and scientists alike.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S02 E08 — Diabolical Killers
It's a terrifying thought that there are those among us who have the urge to stalk, manipulate, and eventually kill to satisfy some dark craving.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S01 E25 — Beyond Death
Throughout human history, how the dead are treated is as important as how the living are treated, and questions of both death and the afterlife have been at the heart of every known culture.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S02 E01 — Mysterious America
From UFO sightings witnessed by thousands to missing civilizations with evidence left in their wake, North America is filled with unresolved questions and mysteries.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E07 — Mysterious Tombs
Throughout history, humans have buried their dead in caves or chambers, in pyramids or in some form of a tomb; ancient tombs were visual memorials for the dead; in China, a vast necropolis was constructed as a way to connect to the afterlife.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E16 — Amazing Animal Abilities
A dog that can detect cancer faster than doctors can do it by using sophisticated equipment; a horse that can read minds; birds that can sense disaster days before it happens.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E02 — Mysterious Structures
For centuries, archaeologists have tried to unravel the mysteries of how and why certain incredible structures like the Great Pyramid at Giza, the staircase at Loretto Chapel, and Coral Castle were built.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E03 — Strange Creatures
Millions of people around the world claim to have had an encounter with a creature unlike any recognized by mainstream science such as the Mothman, Chupacabra, and Mongolian Death Worm.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S08 E15 — Alien Close Encounters
For decades, UFO sightings have been reported by military pilots, civilians and even entire communities, and while many have been explained, some continue to defy conventional answers.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E04 — Unnatural Nature
Probing the Windsor Hum and Old Faithful; visiting a Venezuelan lake where lightning rains down 300 nights a year; sizing up the massive underground fire that's been burning in Centralia, Pa., since 1962.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S08 E01 — Impossible Ancient Structures
All over the world stand ancient structures so massive, precise, and baffling that they seem impossible for not just their time, but ours as well.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E01 — Evil Places
Deadly forests, haunted houses, and mountains where visitors never return alive; a look at what constitutes an evil place and whether these locations are imbued with dark energy that is currently beyond understanding.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S02 E01 — The Greatest Escapes
Stories of escape that defy explanation; Harry Houdini pulls off escape acts; an attempted prison break from Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary; one man receives guidance that allows him to escape the South Tower of the World Trade Center on 9/11.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E08 — Incredible Survivors
A look at how some people live through the impossible such as plane crashes, freezing temperatures, or performing superhuman feats while in danger; remarkable tales of human survival force others to reconsider what is known about the will to live.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S08 E11 — The Lost World of the Aztecs
Five centuries after the fall of the Aztec Empire, new discoveries are revealing that this lost civilization may have been far more sophisticated—and far stranger—than history has long suggested; what secrets remain buried beneath Mexico?

title: The UnXplained
description:
S02 E02 — Superhuman Senses
The five senses: sight, smell, hearing, taste and touch; constructing the reality of the world around us, like a blank canvas continuously painted and repainted every day.

Adam Richman visits a central Pennsylvanian cheese maker with an award-winning mozzarella; inside grocery giant Kroger as they slice, shred and package over 2.5-million lbs. of cheese per week.

Mike comes across a 150-year-old Martin guitar; a rifle-toting homeowner's property is off limits until the guys do some fast talking; Danielle gets a vintage Indian motor appraised.

title: American Pickers

Mike dives into an amazing Michigan collection, but Frank seems to have lost his picking mojo; the guys visit a Wisconsin property that features a reconstituted vintage town; Frank senses engine trouble with the van while Mike ignores the signs.

title: American Pickers
description:

A sprawling warehouse and overstuffed semi trailers on Kevin's New England property; a former race car driver with an amazing collection of automotive artifacts; a sprawling Harley-Davidson honey hole.

title: American Pickers
description:

In 1930, a New York Supreme Court justice with close ties to Tammany Hall, and future president Franklin Delano Roosevelt, steps out of a steakhouse and disappears; for decades, the case dominates mainstream media and remains unsolved.

description:
The Hunt for Adolf Eichmann: WWII Edition
At the end of World War II, many Nazi officials were captured and tried for their crimes; but one of the architects of the Holocaust, Adolf Eichmann, slipped through the cracks, repeatedly eluding Nazi hunters from around the globe.
